scripts.check:fast: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build:app

scripts.test:pipeline-education-fingerprint: uv run --project data_pipeline --group test --frozen python -m pytest data_pipeline/tests/test_education_task_fingerprint.py data_pipeline/tests/test_education_fingerprint_skip.py
scripts.test:pipeline-build-decoupling: uv run --project data_pipeline --group test --frozen python -m pytest data_pipeline/tests/test_update_build_decoupling.py data_pipeline/tests/test_update_static_data.py
scripts.test:pipeline-profiling: uv run --project data_pipeline --group test --frozen python -m pytest data_pipeline/tests/test_pipeline_profiling.py
